# GradTensor

> A specialist AI consultancy with its own method and its own tool.

GradTensor is a specialist AI consultancy for mid-size businesses. We decide where AI belongs with our own method, the Judgment Line, build the systems on our own platform, Forge, and keep them governed - always under your control. We work with owner-led and mid-size businesses across industries, wherever there is real operational complexity and little in-house AI. Based in India, founded as a venture of Sudhanva Labs LLP.

## What we do

### 01 Govern your people's AI - governed enablement of individual AI use
- A clear usage policy, hands-on training on your actual work, and AI Copilots and AI Experts in a private, protected workspace on Forge
- Your company and client data stays under your control; data handling, retention, and access controls documented for IT and compliance review

### 02 Decide what to automate - the Judgment Line Assessment
- We map your operations and draw the line, workflow by workflow, between what AI should run, what it should assist, and what must stay with your people
- Output: a prioritised view of hours to win back and the work that must keep human judgment

### 03 Build your business systems - AI Trackers and AI Automations, built on Forge
- Systems of record: AI Trackers for the leads, orders, quality checks, and logs you now run on spreadsheets and WhatsApp
- Systems of action: AI Automations that run selected workflows end to end, monitoring your logs against your thresholds and generating your recurring reports, while your people govern the exceptions

### 04 Govern and improve - ongoing governance of your AI operations
- Review what AI did, tune the thresholds, handle the exceptions process, and redraw the Judgment Line as your business changes
- Done with you on an ongoing basis so the systems stay dependable as they grow

## The four products

- AI Copilots (Create): help your people produce their work faster
- AI Trackers (Track): keep your business records and answer from them
- AI Experts (Ask): authoritative answers from your company's knowledge
- AI Automations (Run): run processes end to end while your people govern the exceptions

## The Judgment Line

Our method for drawing the line between what AI carries and what stays with your people. Final quality sign-off, contractual and pricing commitments, safety-critical and compliance decisions, and final verification never cross the line. This is what makes the automation governed and safe for a risk-aware business.

## Forge

Our platform for governed AI - AI Copilots, Trackers, Experts, and Automations for business operations. Any mid-size business can use Forge; in a GradTensor engagement, we deploy and govern it for you, end to end, on your real work. Product site: https://forge.gradtensor.com
